meters.name: Agent tool invocation (Prompt, Agent flow, Computer use, Custom connector, MCP, REST API)
Agent flow action
meters.note: 13 credits per 100 actions; fixed cost regardless of users. Reduced by the share of users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence, as in the Copilot Studio estimator (no charge only when the flow is triggered by the agent for a licensed user).

meters.name: Knowledge response with tenant graph grounding (Enhanced Search on)
meters.note: 10 credits tenant graph grounding + 2 credits generative answer (Copilot Studio billing rates; Copilot Studio estimator). Needs Enhanced Search.

meters.name: Knowledge response, non-tenant grounding (Dataverse, web, files)
meters.note: Generative answer from Dataverse, websites or files (Copilot Studio billing rates; Copilot Studio estimator).

meters.name: Prompt modifier - Basic
meters.note: (5 + 0.1) credits per 10 responses, as in the Copilot Studio estimator.

meters.name: Prompt modifier - Standard
meters.note: (5 + 1.5) credits per 10 responses, as in the Copilot Studio estimator.

meters.name: Prompt modifier - Premium
meters.note: (5 + 10) credits per 10 responses, as in the Copilot Studio estimator.

meters.name: Copilot harness - task by intensity (low and high end; heavy tasks have no upper bound)
meters.note: Microsoft Copilot Credit planning model (https://aka.ms/CopilotCreditPlanningModel), Microsoft Copilot Harness. Light: few sources, light reasoning, one output. Medium: many sources, structured reasoning, 2+ outputs. Heavy: broad aggregation, deep reasoning, many outputs.

meters.name: Cowork - credits per person per working day by persona and intensity (low and high end of Microsoft's planning range)
meters.note: Microsoft Copilot Credit planning model, Cowork persona data (https://aka.ms/CopilotCreditPlanningModel). Monthly credits = people x 22 working days x rate. Cowork needs a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence; its credits are billed on top.

meters.name: Contact Center Intelligence - Customer Assist conversation by channel and intensity (low and high end)
meters.note: Microsoft Copilot Credit planning model (https://aka.ms/CopilotCreditPlanningModel), Contact Center Intelligence. Digital: per conversation. Voice: GenAI voice at 10-15 credits a minute over about 2, 5 or 10 minutes. Not included: Premium (speech-to-speech) voice at 17-22 credits a minute, voice biometrics at 12 credits a conversation, and the Quality Assurance and Service Operations agents.

meters.name: Teams Phone Agent - handled call by intensity
meters.note: Microsoft Copilot Credit planning model (https://aka.ms/CopilotCreditPlanningModel), Teams Phone Agent. Light: about 0-60 seconds, a simple information request.

meters.name: Copilot Managed Runtime for Apps - app per month by intensity (low and high end)
meters.note: Microsoft Copilot Credit planning model (https://aka.ms/CopilotCreditPlanningModel), Copilot Managed Runtime for Apps. Light: small personal or team apps. Medium: departmental apps with several connectors. Heavy: enterprise or business-unit apps with heavy connector traffic.

meters.name: WorkIQ API - task by intensity
meters.note: Microsoft Copilot Credit planning model (https://aka.ms/CopilotCreditPlanningModel), WorkIQ API.
